patch.role: Space-only trimming before the numeric grammar check.

inputs.mask_space_padded_leading_zero: space-padded integer with a leading zero (rejected after trimming)
inputs.expose_tab_padded_leading_zero: tab-padded integer: A trims the tabs and rejects it, the space-only repair accepts it

rationale: The numeric grammar check trims surrounding whitespace before applying the leading-zero rule. The patch restores trimming for spaces only; a tab-padded literal keeps its tabs, the leading character is no longer '0', and the check wrongly accepts it - the exposing witness.
